criteria.text: All text, numbers, table dimensions, paragraph order, and table-external content are preserved except formatting-only XML changes.
The normal case spans at least three rendered pages and every continuation page visibly repeats the complete two-row header block without duplicated or omitted data rows.
The normal case has the intended top, header-bottom, and final bottom rules, with no visible vertical borders, internal body grid, diagonal borders, double rules, or decorative shading.
Every rendered page of the normal case has no clipping, overlap, missing glyphs, blank continuation page, or excessive pagination gap attributable to row keep settings.
The caption remains with the table start and the note remains after the final table row with clear ownership.

For a body row taller than one page, the run either preserves all content in a visually complete render using an explicitly justified row-splitting exception, or stops without producing a completed output and states the exact human decision needed.
The over-page case is not marked visual PASS unless every rendered page has been inspected and all source tokens remain visible and extractable.
The non-data layout-table case is classified as not applicable, remains unmodified, and produces no formatted DOCX.
The local bundle contains only its manifest-listed files, excludes checklist.md and F01/F20 semantics, and gains no cache/log/intermediate files during execution.
Execution records the actual runtime, commands, input/output hashes, renderer, page count, and separate structural and visual findings without claiming scientific or journal certification.
Independent review can decide all criteria from raw requests, logs, outputs, manifests, structural checks, and page images without receiving the diagnosis or intended fix.
